what_it_holds: How many companies match the search in all of SAM.gov (not per page).
why: Shows the pool size (2151 for VA 541512).

what_it_holds: URL of this page of results; the key is replaced with a placeholder.
why: Not stored per lead.

what_it_holds: URL for the next 10 results.
why: Use it to fetch more pages later.

what_it_holds: The company's official registered name.
why: Lead name on every screen and in emails.

what_it_holds: The trade name the company uses, if different from the legal name.
why: Friendlier name to show and to search by.

what_it_holds: The company's unique 12-character ID in SAM.gov.
why: Our lead ID; builds the SAM.gov source link.

what_it_holds: A second government supplier ID used mainly by Defense.
why: Not needed for outreach.

what_it_holds: Whether the company has a full SAM.gov registration (Yes/No).
why: Always Yes because we only ask for active registrations.

what_it_holds: Whether the registration is currently Active.
why: Shown as a status badge; confirms the lead is live.

what_it_holds: When the company first registered in SAM.gov.
why: Signal: newly registered companies need help.

what_it_holds: When the current registration runs out unless renewed (365 days after submission).
why: MAIN 'why now' signal for outreach and scoring.

what_it_holds: When the latest registration or renewal went live.
why: Signal: shows when they last renewed.

what_it_holds: When the record was last changed. RULE: drop records updated before 2022-04-04.
why: Needed for the CLAUDE.md data rule; shown as data freshness.

what_it_holds: Who verified the company's identity. 'E&Y' (Ernst & Young) is allowed. RULE: drop if it shows 'D&B'.
why: Needed for the CLAUDE.md D&B rule; proves compliance.

what_it_holds: Extra marker for Dun & Bradstreet data. Empty in all our records.
why: Backup check for the D&B rule, then not stored.

what_it_holds: Code for what the company registered for.
why: Description is enough, and not needed for outreach.

what_it_holds: Whether it registered for contracts, grants, or all awards.
why: Not useful for Maria's outreach.

what_it_holds: Whether the company ID itself is active.
why: Same as registration status for our leads.

what_it_holds: When the company ID was created.
why: Registration date covers this.

what_it_holds: When the company ID expires. Usually empty.
why: Empty in all records.

what_it_holds: Whether the record may be shown publicly (Y/N).
why: Only use records marked Y, then not stored.

what_it_holds: Whether the company is banned from federal work (Y/N).
why: Drop excluded companies; never pitch them.

what_it_holds: Link to exclusion details if banned. Usually empty.
why: We drop excluded companies anyway.

what_it_holds: Electronic payment routing indicator. Usually empty.
why: Payment detail; not relevant.

what_it_holds: Defense activity address code. Usually empty for businesses.
why: Not relevant.

what_it_holds: The website the company listed in SAM.gov. Missing for about half.

what_it_holds: When the business was founded.
